digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify gate and External Integration Tests
propositions: Complete real-Pandoc corpus replay on every Gerrit Verify cell contributes a measured 184.32-second macOS lower bound that must be moved out of the per-change hot path.

Deterministic committed Pandoc outputs for all 178 corpus bodies and 1,383 ordered settling conversions must replace live subprocess invocations in Gerrit Verify while preserving all assertion classes, OS/Python cells, and contractual behavioral coverage.

A dedicated external-integration workflow job must perform full corpus replay through real Pandoc on ubuntu-latest and macos-latest on a weekly schedule and via workflow_dispatch to maintain complete replay coverage outside the per-change gate.

Three evidence-selected live product-path bodies (one per code_arrow/table/prose stratum) plus compact version/platform/argv/stdin/timeout probes must remain in Gerrit Verify to catch production conversion path defects that static outputs cannot detect.
